digest.component_or_area: documentation and public CLI guide for file-impact scope contract
propositions: Tri-state file-impact semantics (undeclared, paths, none) are implemented but documented incompletely across four reader-facing locations.
Public rebar explain plan command must communicate the three file-impact choices, the set-file-impact command, and advisory no-file-impact LLM review.

Standalone gate, ticket-model, and event-schema docs must each clearly define undeclared as unscoped whole-HEAD, paths as dependency-scoped file declarations, and none as authenticated empty-set with substantive reason.
Event replacement semantics—paths clears reason, none clears paths, undeclared clears both—must be documented without ambiguity.
Docs-only and test-only repository work must declare paths; none requires separate reason explaining why no repository file changes and where output or evidence lives.
